Job Description: Broadcom’s Mainframe Software Division (MSD) is committed to addressing the fundamental needs of our customers by continuously evolving our solutions. We are seeking a Product Owner to join our Workload Automation team in Plano, TX, where you will collaborate closely with R&D to deliver enhancements and new capabilities to a suite of workload automation programs that run the world's largest enterprises. These solutions orchestrate workflows to ensure applications such as payroll gets processed on time, financial institutions start the morning with the correct balance, and so forth. The Product Owner (PO) at Broadcom is essentially the “glue code” between Product Manager (PM) and the Development Team, with their primary value derived from understanding, contributing to, and executing the product and solution strategy. This execution involves breaking down high-level strategic goals into concrete outcomes, which are then further refined with the development team into manageable Enablers or User Stories ready for completion. The PO works on-site within the R&D scrum teams to determine how the work will be completed and is responsible for ensuring what the team has developed successfully covers the customer validated use cases. Additionally, the PO leads customer engagement and customer validation efforts. Product Owner Core Responsibilities Works closely with R&D development teams to maximize the value delivered to the customers Understands how the Enterprise backlog model operates with Epics, Capabilities, Features, and Stories Effectively communicates with both internal and external stakeholders Establishes, prioritizes, and helps sequence backlog items based on defined strategies, events, and dependencies with other teams Ensures the common understanding of backlog items, their acceptance criteria and alignment on definition of done with R&D scrum teams Coordinates with other Product Owners and cross-functional roles throughout the development and delivery process Independently resolves complex project issues and challenges Team Backlog Ownership The principal responsibility of the PO is to maintain a prioritized, transparent, and straightforward backlog of work items that align with the product strategy and enable maximizing the product value. Refines the backlog items with R&D teams to reach a common understanding with sufficient detail for the team to work on for the current and next iteration. Cross-Team and Management Reporting To maintain cadence across many teams globally, PO communication is key to ensure inter-team and cross-team dependencies are communicated and risks to team productivity are shared and mitigated. The PO is responsible for raising information to enable management by exception and is accountable for communication with their PO peers and solution leadership. The PO raises dependencies and potential derailers early so they can be addressed in a timely manner without impacting the delivery schedule. The PO regularly leads projects requiring coordination with other functions or teams while providing guidance to less experienced team members. Customer Engagement Our business success is driven by our customers and in turn by their success. In order to ensure our products solve our customers' challenges we continually iterate on our solutions asking our customers for their feedback. A PO works with their PM and other cross-functional roles, including field technical consultants, creating opportunities to visit customers and observe users in their environment whenever possible. PO actively seeks new opportunities for engagement with customers, builds and strengthens customer relationships. Regular iteration reviews are one of the responsibilities of the PO. The PO decides when it is appropriate to share progress with internal and external stakeholders. In establishing the Sprint Review event, the PO will invite their customers describing the value they may expect to receive. Typically performed over video conferencing, a Sprint Review will showcase the most recent development. Presenting at industry conferences on their product, the technical vertical into which our products integrate, and on relevant adjacencies is strongly encouraged for all POs. When a support case is escalated to the development team for further action, the PO must be aware of the case and may manage the case to completion. Collaboration with Product Manager The PO stands back to back with the PM, working together on the same broader problems but each tackling different areas of work and levels of detail. While the Product Manager is considered ‘outward facing’ in meeting potential customers and buyers, the Product Owner is considered ‘inward facing’ and focused on existing customers and colleagues in development and support. The close collaboration of PO with PM is crucial for the creation of a product roadmap, adjustments and execution on the product strategy, and the overall success of the product Product management oversees market research, monitors competitive activity, and identifies customer needs . Collaboration with Development Teams Consisting of developers, architects, QA, Information Engineers, UX, and R&D management, the Development Team produces the vast majority of consumable output and answers the question “How” will this thing get done. The PO closely collaborates with development teams to ensure the items with the highest business value are prioritized, refined, understood, and ready for the development teams to pull into their iterations. PO represents the “voice” of the customers and internal stakeholders towards the team. Required Skills & Qualifications Bachelor’s degree with a minimum 8 years of related experience or Masters degree and 6+ years of related experience Agile Product Ownership: Proven ability to own, prioritize, and groom a product backlog while translating high-level roadmap items into actionable User Stories and Enablers. Strategic Execution: Experience in breaking down complex technical requirements into concrete outcomes with clear Acceptance Criteria. Leadership Experience: Demonstrated ability to influence cross-functional teams without direct authority, fostering a high-performance culture focused on quality and delivery. Expert Stakeholder Management: Demonstrated success in managing complex relationships with diverse stakeholders, including customers, executive leadership, and engineering. Job Description: Broadcom is a leading global company in infrastructure technology, data center networking, and security, built on decades of innovation, collaboration, and engineering excellence. The Application Networking and Security (ANS) division develops advanced security solutions—including distributed firewall and micro-segmentation technologies—that protect east-west traffic across enterprise data centers. We have an exciting opportunity for a Member of Technical Staff (Professional 4) to join our Security Intelligence Big Data and Analytics team. Today's enterprise networks face an expanding attack surface and an ever-changing threat landscape. Our team is on a mission to meet this challenge by delivering powerful, cutting-edge capabilities for VMware vDefend Advanced Threat Prevention (ATP) and the VMware vDefend Firewall . Hosted on the Security Services Platform (SSP) , Security Intelligence is a state-of-the-art analytics platform that provides deep network security visibility within virtualized data centers. It streamlines software-defined Layer 3-7 firewall network segmentation by offering graphical visualization of workloads and traffic flows, alongside automated security policy recommendations that enable micro-segmentation at massive scale. Our team is looking for engineers who share our passion for innovation in distributed systems, container networking, and big data. You will be working within a massive, polyglot repo using technologies like Kubernetes, Kafka, Redis, MinIO, Apache Spark, and PostgreSQL to empower Security Analysts to keep their environments safe from malicious threats. What You'll Actually Work On Network Policy & Micro-segmentation — Building the analytics engines that generate dynamic policy recommendations to eliminate lateral threat movement. Datacenter-Wide Graphical Visualization — Delivering comprehensive, near real-time graphical visualization of Applications, Groups, VMs, IPs, and aggregated network traffic flows to provide deep visibility into complex modern applications. Metadata Ingestion & "Security as Code" — Building robust data pipelines to ingest Configuration Management Database (CMDB) metadata, automating the definition of hierarchies, bulk tag assignments, group creation, and policy bootstrapping—reducing segmentation planning from months to minutes. Continuous Segmentation Monitoring & Drift Detection — Developing tools that continuously monitor network traffic to surface new or unapproved flows, track traffic leakage (for infrastructure workloads and between environments), and alert administrators to unauthorized activity, ensuring continuous compliance. Runtime Threat Detection & High-Throughput Streaming — Building detection capabilities that identify anomalous behavior and policy violations using high-throughput data processing systems. Distributed & Stateful Workloads — Configuring and managing workloads that require consensus, replication, and fault tolerance—including analytical databases and message buses running on Kubernetes via Operators or StatefulSets. How You'll Work Own components end-to-end — From breaking down ambiguous problems into clear technical design specs, test driven development through to production support. Develop Polyglot Systems — Writing highly performant and scalable code using Go, Java, and Python. Debug across layers — Diagnosing complex issues spanning the Kubernetes control plane, networking (TCP/UDP, HTTP, Antrea CNI, Envoy proxies), and cluster-level stateful workloads using Prometheus, Grafana, kubectl debug, and audit logs. Build automated tests — Validating security correctness and OpenAPI compliance to prevent regressions in a highly scalable micro-service environment. Collaborate across teams — Working closely with platform, UI, and QA engineers, while sharing knowledge and mentoring junior engineers. Ship in agile sprints — Participating in all phases of the software development cycle, utilizing Jira, Confluence, and Git-based workflows. What Makes You a Strong Fit Kubernetes Internals — Hands-on experience with Kubernetes architecture and cluster management. Strong Programming Skills — Deep expertise in Go, Java (big data, stream processing, Spring/SpringBoot), and Python. Distributed Systems & Stateful Workloads — Experience managing consensus, replication, fault tolerance, and running databases (e.g., PostgreSQL-HA, Redis) on Kubernetes. High-Volume Data Systems — Experience with analytical databases (e.g., Apache Druid, ClickHouse), large-scale data ingestion (Kafka), and complex querying workloads. Modern Build Tooling — Experience working in large repos using advanced build systems like Bazel, alongside Docker/Helm deployments. Collaborative Mindset — Ability to work independently on complex problems while collaborating across a global team with a "Team First" mentality. Experience with VMware vDefend / DFW is a strong plus. Education & Experience Bachelor's degree in Engineering/Computer Science and 8+ years of related experience, or Master's degree in Engineering/Computer Science and 6+ years of related experience. Job Description: Broadcom’s Mainframe Software Division (MSD) is committed to addressing the fundamental needs of our customers by continuously evolving our solutions. We are seeking a Product Owner to join our Workload Automation team in Plano, TX, where you will collaborate closely with R&D to deliver enhancements and new capabilities to a suite of workload automation programs that run the world's largest enterprises. These solutions orchestrate workflows to ensure applications such as payroll gets processed on time, financial institutions start the morning with the correct balance, and so forth. The Product Owner (PO) at Broadcom is essentially the “glue code” between Product Manager (PM) and the Development Team, with their primary value derived from understanding, contributing to, and executing the product and solution strategy. This execution involves breaking down high-level strategic goals into concrete outcomes, which are then further refined with the development team into manageable Enablers or User Stories ready for completion. The PO works on-site within the R&D scrum teams to determine how the work will be completed and is responsible for ensuring what the team has developed successfully covers the customer validated use cases. Additionally, the PO leads customer engagement and customer validation efforts. Product Owner Core Responsibilities Works closely with R&D development teams to maximize the value delivered to the customers Understands how the Enterprise backlog model operates with Epics, Capabilities, Features, and Stories Effectively communicates with both internal and external stakeholders Establishes, prioritizes, and helps sequence backlog items based on defined strategies, events, and dependencies with other teams Ensures the common understanding of backlog items, their acceptance criteria and alignment on definition of done with R&D scrum teams Coordinates with other Product Owners and cross-functional roles throughout the development and delivery process Independently resolves complex project issues and challenges Team Backlog Ownership The principal responsibility of the PO is to maintain a prioritized, transparent, and straightforward backlog of work items that align with the product strategy and enable maximizing the product value. Refines the backlog items with R&D teams to reach a common understanding with sufficient detail for the team to work on for the current and next iteration. Cross-Team and Management Reporting To maintain cadence across many teams globally, PO communication is key to ensure inter-team and cross-team dependencies are communicated and risks to team productivity are shared and mitigated. The PO is responsible for raising information to enable management by exception and is accountable for communication with their PO peers and solution leadership. The PO raises dependencies and potential derailers early so they can be addressed in a timely manner without impacting the delivery schedule. The PO regularly leads projects requiring coordination with other functions or teams while providing guidance to less experienced team members. Customer Engagement Our business success is driven by our customers and in turn by their success. In order to ensure our products solve our customers' challenges we continually iterate on our solutions asking our customers for their feedback. A PO works with their PM and other cross-functional roles, including field technical consultants, creating opportunities to visit customers and observe users in their environment whenever possible. PO actively seeks new opportunities for engagement with customers, builds and strengthens customer relationships. Regular iteration reviews are one of the responsibilities of the PO. The PO decides when it is appropriate to share progress with internal and external stakeholders. In establishing the Sprint Review event, the PO will invite their customers describing the value they may expect to receive. Typically performed over video conferencing, a Sprint Review will showcase the most recent development. Presenting at industry conferences on their product, the technical vertical into which our products integrate, and on relevant adjacencies is strongly encouraged for all POs. When a support case is escalated to the development team for further action, the PO must be aware of the case and may manage the case to completion. Collaboration with Product Manager The PO stands back to back with the PM, working together on the same broader problems but each tackling different areas of work and levels of detail. While the Product Manager is considered ‘outward facing’ in meeting potential customers and buyers, the Product Owner is considered ‘inward facing’ and focused on existing customers and colleagues in development and support. The close collaboration of PO with PM is crucial for the creation of a product roadmap, adjustments and execution on the product strategy, and the overall success of the product Product management oversees market research, monitors competitive activity, and identifies customer needs . Collaboration with Development Teams Consisting of developers, architects, QA, Information Engineers, UX, and R&D management, the Development Team produces the vast majority of consumable output and answers the question “How” will this thing get done. The PO closely collaborates with development teams to ensure the items with the highest business value are prioritized, refined, understood, and ready for the development teams to pull into their iterations. PO represents the “voice” of the customers and internal stakeholders towards the team. Required Skills & Qualifications Bachelor’s degree with a minimum 8 years of related experience or Masters degree and 6+ years of related experience Agile Product Ownership: Proven ability to own, prioritize, and groom a product backlog while translating high-level roadmap items into actionable User Stories and Enablers. Strategic Execution: Experience in breaking down complex technical requirements into concrete outcomes with clear Acceptance Criteria. Leadership Experience: Demonstrated ability to influence cross-functional teams without direct authority, fostering a high-performance culture focused on quality and delivery. Expert Stakeholder Management: Demonstrated success in managing complex relationships with diverse stakeholders, including customers, executive leadership, and engineering. Ability to navigate competing priorities and communicate "the why" behind product decisions with clarity and diplomacy. Stakeholder Collaboration: Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to bridge the gap between R&D engineering teams and business-oriented Product Managers. Job Description: Broadcom is a leading global company in infrastructure technology, data center networking, and security, built on decades of innovation, collaboration, and engineering excellence. The Application Networking and Security (ANS) division develops advanced security solutions—including distributed firewall and micro-segmentation technologies—that protect east-west traffic across enterprise data centers. We have an exciting opportunity for a Member of Technical Staff (Professional 4) to join our Security Intelligence Big Data and Analytics team. Today's enterprise networks face an expanding attack surface and an ever-changing threat landscape. Our team is on a mission to meet this challenge by delivering powerful, cutting-edge capabilities for VMware vDefend Advanced Threat Prevention (ATP) and the VMware vDefend Firewall . Hosted on the Security Services Platform (SSP) , Security Intelligence is a state-of-the-art analytics platform that provides deep network security visibility within virtualized data centers. It streamlines software-defined Layer 3-7 firewall network segmentation by offering graphical visualization of workloads and traffic flows, alongside automated security policy recommendations that enable micro-segmentation at massive scale. Our team is looking for engineers who share our passion for innovation in distributed systems, container networking, and big data. You will be working within a massive, polyglot repo using technologies like Kubernetes, Kafka, Redis, MinIO, Apache Spark, and PostgreSQL to empower Security Analysts to keep their environments safe from malicious threats. What You'll Actually Work On Network Policy & Micro-segmentation — Building the analytics engines that generate dynamic policy recommendations to eliminate lateral threat movement. Datacenter-Wide Graphical Visualization — Delivering comprehensive, near real-time graphical visualization of Applications, Groups, VMs, IPs, and aggregated network traffic flows to provide deep visibility into complex modern applications. Metadata Ingestion & "Security as Code" — Building robust data pipelines to ingest Configuration Management Database (CMDB) metadata, automating the definition of hierarchies, bulk tag assignments, group creation, and policy bootstrapping—reducing segmentation planning from months to minutes. Continuous Segmentation Monitoring & Drift Detection — Developing tools that continuously monitor network traffic to surface new or unapproved flows, track traffic leakage (for infrastructure workloads and between environments), and alert administrators to unauthorized activity, ensuring continuous compliance. Runtime Threat Detection & High-Throughput Streaming — Building detection capabilities that identify anomalous behavior and policy violations using high-throughput data processing systems. Distributed & Stateful Workloads — Configuring and managing workloads that require consensus, replication, and fault tolerance—including analytical databases and message buses running on Kubernetes via Operators or StatefulSets. How You'll Work Own components end-to-end — From breaking down ambiguous problems into clear technical design specs, test driven development through to production support. Develop Polyglot Systems — Writing highly performant and scalable code using Go, Java, and Python. Debug across layers — Diagnosing complex issues spanning the Kubernetes control plane, networking (TCP/UDP, HTTP, Antrea CNI, Envoy proxies), and cluster-level stateful workloads using Prometheus, Grafana, kubectl debug, and audit logs. Build automated tests — Validating security correctness and OpenAPI compliance to prevent regressions in a highly scalable micro-service environment. Collaborate across teams — Working closely with platform, UI, and QA engineers, while sharing knowledge and mentoring junior engineers. Ship in agile sprints — Participating in all phases of the software development cycle, utilizing Jira, Confluence, and Git-based workflows. What Makes You a Strong Fit Kubernetes Internals — Hands-on experience with Kubernetes architecture and cluster management. Strong Programming Skills — Deep expertise in Go, Java (big data, stream processing, Spring/SpringBoot), and Python. Distributed Systems & Stateful Workloads — Experience managing consensus, replication, fault tolerance, and running databases (e.g., PostgreSQL-HA, Redis) on Kubernetes. High-Volume Data Systems — Experience with analytical databases (e.g., Apache Druid, ClickHouse), large-scale data ingestion (Kafka), and complex querying workloads. Modern Build Tooling — Experience working in large repos using advanced build systems like Bazel, alongside Docker/Helm deployments. Collaborative Mindset — Ability to work independently on complex problems while collaborating across a global team with a "Team First" mentality. Experience with VMware vDefend / DFW is a strong plus. Job Description: Broadcom’s Mainframe Software Division (MSD) is committed to addressing the fundamental needs of our customers by continuously evolving our solutions. We are seeking a Product Owner to join our Workload Automation team in Plano, TX, where you will collaborate closely with R&D to deliver enhancements and new capabilities to a suite of workload automation programs that run the world's largest enterprises. These solutions orchestrate workflows to ensure applications such as payroll gets processed on time, financial institutions start the morning with the correct balance, and so forth. The Product Owner (PO) at Broadcom is essentially the “glue code” between Product Manager (PM) and the Development Team, with their primary value derived from understanding, contributing to, and executing the product and solution strategy. This execution involves breaking down high-level strategic goals into concrete outcomes, which are then further refined with the development team into manageable Enablers or User Stories ready for completion. The PO works on-site within the R&D scrum teams to determine how the work will be completed and is responsible for ensuring what the team has developed successfully covers the customer validated use cases. Additionally, the PO leads customer engagement and customer validation efforts. Product Owner Core Responsibilities Works closely with R&D development teams to maximize the value delivered to the customers Understands how the Enterprise backlog model operates with Epics, Capabilities, Features, and Stories Effectively communicates with both internal and external stakeholders Establishes, prioritizes, and helps sequence backlog items based on defined strategies, events, and dependencies with other teams Ensures the common understanding of backlog items, their acceptance criteria and alignment on definition of done with R&D scrum teams Coordinates with other Product Owners and cross-functional roles throughout the development and delivery process Independently resolves complex project issues and challenges Team Backlog Ownership The principal responsibility of the PO is to maintain a prioritized, transparent, and straightforward backlog of work items that align with the product strategy and enable maximizing the product value. Refines the backlog items with R&D teams to reach a common understanding with sufficient detail for the team to work on for the current and next iteration. Cross-Team and Management Reporting To maintain cadence across many teams globally, PO communication is key to ensure inter-team and cross-team dependencies are communicated and risks to team productivity are shared and mitigated. The PO is responsible for raising information to enable management by exception and is accountable for communication with their PO peers and solution leadership. The PO raises dependencies and potential derailers early so they can be addressed in a timely manner without impacting the delivery schedule. The PO regularly leads projects requiring coordination with other functions or teams while providing guidance to less experienced team members. Customer Engagement Our business success is driven by our customers and in turn by their success. In order to ensure our products solve our customers' challenges we continually iterate on our solutions asking our customers for their feedback. A PO works with their PM and other cross-functional roles, including field technical consultants, creating opportunities to visit customers and observe users in their environment whenever possible. PO actively seeks new opportunities for engagement with customers, builds and strengthens customer relationships. Regular iteration reviews are one of the responsibilities of the PO. The PO decides when it is appropriate to share progress with internal and external stakeholders. In establishing the Sprint Review event, the PO will invite their customers describing the value they may expect to receive. Typically performed over video conferencing, a Sprint Review will showcase the most recent development. Presenting at industry conferences on their product, the technical vertical into which our products integrate, and on relevant adjacencies is strongly encouraged for all POs. When a support case is escalated to the development team for further action, the PO must be aware of the case and may manage the case to completion. Collaboration with Product Manager The PO stands back to back with the PM, working together on the same broader problems but each tackling different areas of work and levels of detail. While the Product Manager is considered ‘outward facing’ in meeting potential customers and buyers, the Product Owner is considered ‘inward facing’ and focused on existing customers and colleagues in development and support. The close collaboration of PO with PM is crucial for the creation of a product roadmap, adjustments and execution on the product strategy, and the overall success of the product Product management oversees market research, monitors competitive activity, and identifies customer needs . Collaboration with Development Teams Consisting of developers, architects, QA, Information Engineers, UX, and R&D management, the Development Team produces the vast majority of consumable output and answers the question “How” will this thing get done. The PO closely collaborates with development teams to ensure the items with the highest business value are prioritized, refined, understood, and ready for the development teams to pull into their iterations. PO represents the “voice” of the customers and internal stakeholders towards the team. Required Skills & Qualifications Bachelor’s degree with a minimum 8 years of related experience or Masters degree and 6+ years of related experience Agile Product Ownership: Proven ability to own, prioritize, and groom a product backlog while translating high-level roadmap items into actionable User Stories and Enablers. Strategic Execution: Experience in breaking down complex technical requirements into concrete outcomes with clear Acceptance Criteria. Leadership Experience: Demonstrated ability to influence cross-functional teams without direct authority, fostering a high-performance culture focused on quality and delivery. Expert Stakeholder Management: Demonstrated success in managing complex relationships with diverse stakeholders, including customers, executive leadership, and engineering. Ability to navigate competing priorities and communicate "the why" behind product decisions with clarity and diplomacy. Stakeholder Collaboration: Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to bridge the gap between R&D engineering teams and business-oriented Product Managers. Desired Skills & Qualifications Prior experience as a Product Owner, Business Analyst, or similar role Mainframe Ecosystem Literacy: Foundational knowledge of the z/OS environment, including familiarity with TSO/ISPF. Comfort with JCL and general programming to understand job failures or resource constraints and their potential impact. Direct experience with using or managing mainframe schedulers or Workload Automation products. Experience with CA 7 and/or Jobtrac a plus. Strong business acumen with ability to perform impact analysis for missed batch windows and translate business requirements into jobs run in workload schedulers. Job Description: The Core Switch Group (CSG) at Broadcom is the industry leader in cutting-edge networking ASICs, developing advanced protocols and delivering unmatched port density and bandwidth performance. Our team is behind iconic switching solutions like the Tomahawk and Trident series, setting benchmarks in the networking world. Broadcom, a global innovator in fabless communications semiconductors, software, and systems, is proud to be recognized as one of Fortune magazine's "Most Admired Companies." We foster a culture that embraces change, values risk-taking, and thrives on tackling the impossible. At Broadcom, we reward innovation and initiative with competitive salaries, industry-leading benefits, and opportunities for growth in an open, collaborative work environment. If you're a passionate engineer eager to shape the future of networking, Broadcom is where you can outdo, outsmart, and outperform. Join us and make an impact! Key Responsibilities Conduct detailed studies of chip architecture and micro-architecture to define, develop, and execute comprehensive pre-silicon test plans that thoroughly validate switch features. Verify the design, architecture, and micro-architecture using emulation platforms. Develop sub-system and chip-level tests using Tcl, ITcl, Python, and C/C++ to verify networking switch chips in emulation platforms. Build and synthesize Verilog/SystemVerilog-based models for emulation platforms such as Zebu or Palladium. Perform block-, sub-system-, and chip/system-level debugging and root cause analysis for hardware and software issues, addressing pre-silicon challenges. Support failure analysis of customer-returned parts by reproducing failures, performing deep root-cause analysis, and driving corrective actions teams. Collaborate with post-silicon and system teams to correlate pre-silicon validation results with field observations and ensure architectural intent is maintained in deployed systems. Develop and optimize automation scripts and emulation methodologies to improve efficiency, reusability, and coverage. Create reusable synthesizable design blocks, libraries, and verification components to streamline emulation processes. Build and maintain robust emulation environments that support a global user community. What You Bring Proven ability to define verification strategy and drive execution at block, sub-system, and chip levels for networking ASICs. 8+ years of experience in pre-silicon verification and/or emulation of high-performance networking designs. Strong expertise in Verilog/SystemVerilog, C/C++, and scripting languages (Tcl, Python) for test development and automation. Hands-on experience with hardware emulation platforms (e.g., Zebu, Palladium) and familiarity with high-speed protocols such as PCIe and Ethernet. Deep debugging expertise, including use of DPI transactors, assertions, and coverage methodologies. Experience working cross-functionally with architecture, design, and software teams to ensure architectural intent and silicon quality. Strong communication skills and ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced, collaborative environment. Verification engineers with simulation backgrounds are also encouraged to apply — strong verification fundamentals are highly valued. Job Description: Manufacturing Operator Broadcom Lehigh Valley Manufacturing Operator, Cleanroom In this full-time position with competitive pay and excellent benefits, you will interact with colleagues from both operations and engineering while performing activities critical to Broadcom’s success as a premier manufacturer in the high-technology semiconductor industry. Company History: Broadcom is a multinational technology business that develops, manufactures, and sells semiconductors and infrastructure software . AT&T first opened the Breinigsville facility in the late 1980s and this facility served as Bell Labs’ world headquarters for optoelectronics. Through a series of acquisitions, the Breinigsville facility is now an integral part of Broadcom’s Optical Systems Division, manufacturing InP lasers and detectors that support telecommunications customers throughout the world. Position Summary: This manufacturing position involves operating semiconductor-processing equipment in a cleanroom environment. The manufacturing operator is responsible for meeting daily production goals in support of cleanroom fabrication operations. The areas of concentration include photolithography – both coat/develop and pattern exposure – pattern transfer via both wet and dry etching techniques, substrate cleaning via wet chemistry, metrology and other semiconductor processes. Key Duties and Responsibilities: Operate manually- or computer-controlled equipment to meet production and quality goals Work constructively with other team members to process wafers and optical components Utilize computer software to track operational performance and make minor corrections to improve productivity Follow quality management procedures and identify quality issues Maintain a clean and safe working environment Multitask to perform other required duties as assigned by a supervisor The Ideal Candidate: enjoys working hard in a fast-paced, collaborative environment, is detail-oriented, exhibits strong problem-solving skills as related to equipment and manufacturing issues, is self-directed and able to work with limited supervision Qualification and Experience: Required : High-school diploma or GED. Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and Word computer applications. Ability to perform light lifting and carrying duties, and to sit and/or stand for an extended period of time (3-5 hrs.) Preferred : Previous manufacturing experience in a cleanroom environment. Working Conditions: Duties are performed in a cleanroom environment which requires personnel to wear special garments. Cleanroom suits, hoods, shoe covers and gloves are used to maintain the cleanliness of the workspace Location: The Broadcom – Breinigsville, PA site is located in the Lehigh Valley near the cities of Allentown, Bethlehem and Reading. Title: Maintenance Advisor Job Title: Maintenance Advisor Overview As Maintenance Advisor, you will play a key role in enabling safe, reliable, and efficient maintenance execution at site. Acting as the main interface between the ROO and BOC maintenance teams and site operations, you will guide priorities, coach national staff, and ensure effective work management. Your influence, collaboration, and technical leadership will support timely execution of planned and unplanned maintenance while ensuring strong safety and compliance standards. K ey Responsibilities Leadership Promotes a culture of open safety reporting, continuous improvement, and shared respect across a diverse workforce. Encourages team engagement and promote accountability aligned with ROO’s values and behaviours. Risk / Operating Discipline Accountable for the safe execution of all maintenance activities, ensuring strict adherence to safety standards and risk management protocols. Maintains zero tolerance for overdue maintenance, particularly SCEs and anomalies, and ensures high-quality deferral processes. Maintenance Execution Accountable for effective and efficient asset maintenance across multi-discipline activities, including Preventive (PM) and Corrective Maintenance (CM). Conducts daily validation and maintenance planning meetings to ensure timely prioritization and approval of work. Leads compliance with standardized Work Management processes, including deferral management and risk mitigation. Oversees contractor-executed tasks by reviewing CTRs for scope quality, cost, resource utilization, materials, and duration. Manages scaffolding needs by initiating requests and ensuring prompt dismantling after completion. Maintains up-to-date records in the O&M tracker and supports reporting accuracy. Owns and maintains the ROO choke model for assigned sites to ensure plant vulnerabilities are understood, tracked, and addressed. Drives plant and equipment availability and supports reliability improvement initiatives, ensuring RCFA actions are followed through to closure. People Coaches and develops direct reports to support the nationalisation agenda, ensuring timely delivery of personal development plans aligned with the nationalisation plan. Delivery, Optimization & Reliability Recommends execution optimization opportunities to the METL and manages the 12-week maintenance activity schedule, deciding what enters the 2-week execution window. Ensures nesting of activities and addresses risks before scheduling, supports timely change management (MOC) and Engineering Queries to meet business objectives. Assists operations in returning plant to safe operation post-interventions, ensuring timely closeout of GOC paperwork, walkdowns, and PSSR sign-offs. Job Description: Broadcom is a leading global company in infrastructure technology, data center networking, and security, built on decades of innovation, collaboration, and engineering excellence. The Application Networking and Security (ANS) division develops advanced security solutions—including distributed firewall and micro-segmentation technologies—that protect east-west traffic across enterprise data centers. We have an exciting opportunity for a Member of Technical Staff (Professional 4) to join our Security Intelligence Big Data and Analytics team. Today's enterprise networks face an expanding attack surface and an ever-changing threat landscape. Our team is on a mission to meet this challenge by delivering powerful, cutting-edge capabilities for VMware vDefend Advanced Threat Prevention (ATP) and the VMware vDefend Firewall . Hosted on the Security Services Platform (SSP) , Security Intelligence is a state-of-the-art analytics platform that provides deep network security visibility within virtualized data centers. It streamlines software-defined Layer 3-7 firewall network segmentation by offering graphical visualization of workloads and traffic flows, alongside automated security policy recommendations that enable micro-segmentation at massive scale. Our team is looking for engineers who share our passion for innovation in distributed systems, container networking, and big data. You will be working within a massive, polyglot repo using technologies like Kubernetes, Kafka, Redis, MinIO, Apache Spark, and PostgreSQL to empower Security Analysts to keep their environments safe from malicious threats. What You'll Actually Work On Network Policy & Micro-segmentation — Building the analytics engines that generate dynamic policy recommendations to eliminate lateral threat movement. Datacenter-Wide Graphical Visualization — Delivering comprehensive, near real-time graphical visualization of Applications, Groups, VMs, IPs, and aggregated network traffic flows to provide deep visibility into complex modern applications. Metadata Ingestion & "Security as Code" — Building robust data pipelines to ingest Configuration Management Database (CMDB) metadata, automating the definition of hierarchies, bulk tag assignments, group creation, and policy bootstrapping—reducing segmentation planning from months to minutes. Continuous Segmentation Monitoring & Drift Detection — Developing tools that continuously monitor network traffic to surface new or unapproved flows, track traffic leakage (for infrastructure workloads and between environments), and alert administrators to unauthorized activity, ensuring continuous compliance. Runtime Threat Detection & High-Throughput Streaming — Building detection capabilities that identify anomalous behavior and policy violations using high-throughput data processing systems. Distributed & Stateful Workloads — Configuring and managing workloads that require consensus, replication, and fault tolerance—including analytical databases and message buses running on Kubernetes via Operators or StatefulSets. How You'll Work Own components end-to-end — From breaking down ambiguous problems into clear technical design specs, test driven development through to production support. Develop Polyglot Systems — Writing highly performant and scalable code using Go, Java, and Python. Debug across layers — Diagnosing complex issues spanning the Kubernetes control plane, networking (TCP/UDP, HTTP, Antrea CNI, Envoy proxies), and cluster-level stateful workloads using Prometheus, Grafana, kubectl debug, and audit logs. Build automated tests — Validating security correctness and OpenAPI compliance to prevent regressions in a highly scalable micro-service environment. Collaborate across teams — Working closely with platform, UI, and QA engineers, while sharing knowledge and mentoring junior engineers. Ship in agile sprints — Participating in all phases of the software development cycle, utilizing Jira, Confluence, and Git-based workflows. What Makes You a Strong Fit Kubernetes Internals — Hands-on experience with Kubernetes architecture and cluster management. Strong Programming Skills — Deep expertise in Go, Java (big data, stream processing, Spring/SpringBoot), and Python. Distributed Systems & Stateful Workloads — Experience managing consensus, replication, fault tolerance, and running databases (e.g., PostgreSQL-HA, Redis) on Kubernetes. High-Volume Data Systems — Experience with analytical databases (e.g., Apache Druid, ClickHouse), large-scale data ingestion (Kafka), and complex querying workloads. Modern Build Tooling ��— Experience working in large repos using advanced build systems like Bazel, alongside Docker/Helm deployments. Collaborative Mindset — Ability to work independently on complex problems while collaborating across a global team with a "Team First" mentality. Experience with VMware vDefend / DFW is a strong plus. Education & Experience Bachelor's degree in Engineering/Computer Science and 8+ years of related experience, or Master's degree in Engineering/Computer Science and 6+ years of related experience. Job Description: Broadcom’s Mainframe Software Division (MSD) is committed to addressing the fundamental needs of our customers by continuously evolving our solutions. We are seeking a Product Owner to join our Workload Automation team in Plano, TX, where you will collaborate closely with R&D to deliver enhancements and new capabilities to a suite of workload automation programs that run the world's largest enterprises. These solutions orchestrate workflows to ensure applications such as payroll gets processed on time, financial institutions start the morning with the correct balance, and so forth. The Product Owner (PO) at Broadcom is essentially the “glue code” between Product Manager (PM) and the Development Team, with their primary value derived from understanding, contributing to, and executing the product and solution strategy. This execution involves breaking down high-level strategic goals into concrete outcomes, which are then further refined with the development team into manageable Enablers or User Stories ready for completion. The PO works on-site within the R&D scrum teams to determine how the work will be completed and is responsible for ensuring what the team has developed successfully covers the customer validated use cases. Additionally, the PO leads customer engagement and customer validation efforts. Product Owner Core Responsibilities Works closely with R&D development teams to maximize the value delivered to the customers Understands how the Enterprise backlog model operates with Epics, Capabilities, Features, and Stories Effectively communicates with both internal and external stakeholders Establishes, prioritizes, and helps sequence backlog items based on defined strategies, events, and dependencies with other teams Ensures the common understanding of backlog items, their acceptance criteria and alignment on definition of done with R&D scrum teams Coordinates with other Product Owners and cross-functional roles throughout the development and delivery process Independently resolves complex project issues and challenges Team Backlog Ownership The principal responsibility of the PO is to maintain a prioritized, transparent, and straightforward backlog of work items that align with the product strategy and enable maximizing the product value. Refines the backlog items with R&D teams to reach a common understanding with sufficient detail for the team to work on for the current and next iteration. Cross-Team and Management Reporting To maintain cadence across many teams globally, PO communication is key to ensure inter-team and cross-team dependencies are communicated and risks to team productivity are shared and mitigated. The PO is responsible for raising information to enable management by exception and is accountable for communication with their PO peers and solution leadership. The PO raises dependencies and potential derailers early so they can be addressed in a timely manner without impacting the delivery schedule. The PO regularly leads projects requiring coordination with other functions or teams while providing guidance to less experienced team members. Customer Engagement Our business success is driven by our customers and in turn by their success. In order to ensure our products solve our customers' challenges we continually iterate on our solutions asking our customers for their feedback. A PO works with their PM and other cross-functional roles, including field technical consultants, creating opportunities to visit customers and observe users in their environment whenever possible. PO actively seeks new opportunities for engagement with customers, builds and strengthens customer relationships. Regular iteration reviews are one of the responsibilities of the PO. The PO decides when it is appropriate to share progress with internal and external stakeholders. In establishing the Sprint Review event, the PO will invite their customers describing the value they may expect to receive. Typically performed over video conferencing, a Sprint Review will showcase the most recent development. Presenting at industry conferences on their product, the technical vertical into which our products integrate, and on relevant adjacencies is strongly encouraged for all POs. When a support case is escalated to the development team for further action, the PO must be aware of the case and may manage the case to completion. Collaboration with Product Manager The PO stands back to back with the PM, working together on the same broader problems but each tackling different areas of work and levels of detail. While the Product Manager is considered ‘outward facing’ in meeting potential customers and buyers, the Product Owner is considered ‘inward facing’ and focused on existing customers and colleagues in development and support. The close collaboration of PO with PM is crucial for the creation of a product roadmap, adjustments and execution on the product strategy, and the overall success of the product Product management oversees market research, monitors competitive activity, and identifies customer needs . Collaboration with Development Teams Consisting of developers, architects, QA, Information Engineers, UX, and R&D management, the Development Team produces the vast majority of consumable output and answers the question “How” will this thing get done. The PO closely collaborates with development teams to ensure the items with the highest business value are prioritized, refined, understood, and ready for the development teams to pull into their iterations. PO represents the “voice” of the customers and internal stakeholders towards the team. Required Skills & Qualifications Bachelor’s degree with a minimum 8 years of related experience or Masters degree and 6+ years of related experience Agile Product Ownership: Proven ability to own, prioritize, and groom a product backlog while translating high-level roadmap items into actionable User Stories and Enablers. Strategic Execution: Experience in breaking down complex technical requirements into concrete outcomes with clear Acceptance Criteria. Leadership Experience: Demonstrated ability to influence cross-functional teams without direct authority, fostering a high-performance culture focused on quality and delivery. Expert Stakeholder Management: Demonstrated success in managing complex relationships with diverse stakeholders, including customers, executive leadership, and engineering. Ability to navigate competing priorities and communicate "the why" behind product decisions with clarity and diplomacy. Stakeholder Collaboration: Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to bridge the gap between R&D engineering teams and business-oriented Product Managers. Desired Skills & Qualifications Prior experience as a Product Owner, Business Analyst, or similar role Mainframe Ecosystem Literacy: Foundational knowledge of the z/OS environment, including familiarity with TSO/ISPF. Comfort with JCL and general programming to understand job failures or resource constraints and their potential impact. Direct experience with using or managing mainframe schedulers or Workload Automation products. Experience with CA 7 and/or Jobtrac a plus. Strong business acumen with ability to perform impact analysis for missed batch windows and translate business requirements into jobs run in workload schedulers. Job Description: Equipment Engineer - Metrology The Wireless Semiconductor Division (WSD) designs and develops highly integrated, state-of-the-art RF front-end solutions for use in mobile communications and WiFi access points. Together, we’re enabling our customers to distinguish their products using Broadcom’s differentiated RF semiconductors. As an Equipment Engineer in the Metrology Team, you will be responsible for the reliable operation, optimization, maintenance, and troubleshooting of Metrology equipment within the wafer fabrication facility located in Fort Collins, Colorado. You will work closely with Equipment Maintenance Technicians, Unit Process Engineers (UPE), Industrial Engineering, R&D, and external Vendors to meet high volume manufacturing needs with equipment capabilities. Roles & Responsibilities: Provide technical support for metrology and automated sorting tools used in semiconductor manufacturing, ensuring optimal performance and uptime. Conduct and prescribe preventive and corrective maintenance of metrology equipment, troubleshooting issues to minimize downtime. Collaborate with cross-functional teams (production, process engineers, and technicians) to diagnose and resolve tool issues. Support the installation and qualification of new metrology tools, ensuring they meet manufacturing requirements. Perform calibration, software updates, and tool modifications to maintain equipment specifications. Analyze tool performance data and generate reports to improve tool efficiency and identify potential issues early. Provide training and mentoring to technicians and other team members on tool operation and maintenance. Coordinate support and scheduling with Equipment Vendors to perform maintenance, repairs, and drive continuous improvement projects. Qualifications: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering for Mechanical, Electronics, Computer or related fields. 5 years of experience working with semiconductor manufacturing equipment, preferably metrology tools responsible for defect inspection and measurement. Experience troubleshooting and maintaining complex electro-mechanical systems. Including optical character recognition, robotics and systems that rely on pneumatics, vacuum, and lasers. Excellent teamwork and good verbal and written communication skills. Demonstrated strong partnership skills with Operations and Equipment Maintenance organizations. Good problem solving skills, sound analytical techniques, and an ability to solve problems systematically. Design of Experiment (DOE), characterization, and optimization capabilities. Strong understanding of Statistical Process Control (SPC) and proficiency with data science and SPC software. Familiarity applying Lean manufacturing, Six-Sigma, and similar principles to complex issues. Demonstrates good judgment in selecting methods and techniques for obtaining solutions. Able to work in a clean room environment, adhering to strict cleanliness protocols and wearing required clean room attire to maintain a contamination-free workspace. Job Description: WSD Fort Collins Equipment Maintenance C-Shift (S,M,T, alternating Weds, 6PM-6AM) Supervisor – Job Description Equipment Maintenance Shift Supervisor As an Equipment Maintenance Shift Supervisor with the Wireless Semiconductor Division (WSD), you will be responsible for collaborating with fab operations, equipment engineering, and equipment area teams to sustain and improve equipment reliability and performance, while in support of overall safety, yield, reliability, and productivity goals. You will provide dotted-line management for all equipment maintenance technicians on your assigned shift, as well as take direct responsibility for the equipment support technicians on your shift. The shift supervisor will be responsible for managing a challenging environment, driving continuous improvement initiatives in our existing high-volume Si MEMS production facilities located along the Front Range Mountains in Northern Colorado. We are looking to hire a talented, highly motivated leader responsible for challenging and rewarding work. Specific Objectives and Key Responsibilities: Lead team to deliver safe, stable, and reliable equipment performance. Lead and direct shift technician resources consistent with business-changing needs. Act as the escalation contact for emergency concerns, attendance, etc. Work with Equipment Maintenance Area Supervisors to implement global initiatives (RTQ, PM Checklist, CMMS, LOTO, escalations, CribMaster (automated hand tool system), PM kits, documentation review, etc.) consistent with equipment team standards and improve cross-shift communication performance. Partner with Fab Operations supervisors to ensure our customer and factory needs are understood and met. Allocate resources to the highest priority areas as defined by fab operations. Realign resources based on vacation, call-ins, training, and other area coverage issues. Resolve conflicts between PM schedules and reactive fab operations priorities. Coordinate solutions to equipment issues and involve required resources early on to prevent extended downtime. Encourage precision and excellence when performing maintenance, troubleshooting, and communication activities. Conduct thorough observations of practices and adherence to protocols and procedures, including LOTO activity audits. Enhance the standardization of processes while spending time on the factory floor. Point of contact to drive and support advanced troubleshooting and escalation for the shift. Responsible for ensuring and supporting the training and certification programs in place for the equipment maintenance technicians in their functional area. Provide feedback on global training shift needs. In the absence of the responsible EM Area Supervisor, provide the necessary management intervention for any HR issue that may arise on your shift. Carefully coordinate your actions with that employee’s EM Area Supervisor & HR in a timely manner. Provide input to the EM Area Supervisor for measuring employee performance utilizing the Quarterly Performance Form process (QPF). Drive and support equipment maintenance metric adherence including communication and corrective action plans. Function as project/program manager for assigned cross-functional needs (e.g. Hand Tools Calibration program, CribMaster program, Pack Mule improvement project, AMHS Delivery System, etc.). Drive assigned projects through completion utilizing the PDCA (Plan-Do-Check-Act) process as needed. Participate in the selection & hiring of new technicians for your shift. Provide active direct management of the Equipment Support Team technicians assigned to your shift. Growth, development, accountability, and performance efficiency Drives organizational accountability to policies and procedures Drives continuous improvement with forward-thinking on safety and quality Manage hiring resources as needed Serve as a sounding board and source of advice for employees at any career stage (e.g., new hires through Master Level Technicians). This may encompass technical challenges or personnel/work-relationship difficulties. Skills and Qualifications: Preferred Bachelor’s degree in a related field Required Associate in Applied Science degree in Electronics Engineering Technology or equivalent technical degree. Preferred 8-10 years of experience in semiconductor manufacturing processes, equipment maintenance, and related challenges. Preferred experience includes previous management in equipment maintenance, with a strong emphasis on problem-solving, preventive maintenance planning, time management, and organizational skills. Candidates should possess electrical and mechanical technical knowledge of equipment, along with analytical reasoning abilities. Also has a proven track record of effectively managing a team of technical experts. Demonstrated technical expertise, leadership, and the ability to develop and mentor employees. Demonstrated ability to balance long-term and short-term goals and manage competing priorities. Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment. Experienced team player/team leader. Ability to resolve conflict constructively. The successful candidate is required to participate on Broadcom's Emergency Response Team (ERT). This includes working towards becoming an ERT Incident Commander, leading events, making strategic decisions, and serving as a point of contact for emergency events. Data-driven and results-oriented. Excellent verbal and written communication skills Attention to detail is essential. Initiative to address and appropriately escalate problems to achieve rapid resolution. Company History: Broadcom is a multinational technology business that develops, manufactures, and sells semiconductors and infrastructure software . AT&T first opened the Breinigsville facility in the late 1980s and this facility served as Bell Labs’ world headquarters for optoelectronics. Through a series of acquisitions, the Breinigsville facility is now an integral part of Broadcom’s Optical Systems Division, manufacturing InP lasers and detectors that support telecommunications customers throughout the world. Position Summary: This manufacturing position involves operating semiconductor-processing equipment in a cleanroom environment. The manufacturing operator is responsible for meeting daily production goals in support of cleanroom fabrication operations. The areas of concentration include photolithography – both coat/develop and pattern exposure – pattern transfer via both wet and dry etching techniques, substrate cleaning via wet chemistry, metrology and other semiconductor processes. Key Duties and Responsibilities: Operate manually- or computer-controlled equipment to meet production and quality goals Work constructively with other team members to process wafers and optical components Utilize computer software to track operational performance and make minor corrections to improve productivity Follow quality management procedures and identify quality issues Maintain a clean and safe working environment Multitask to perform other required duties as assigned by a supervisor The Ideal Candidate: enjoys working hard in a fast-paced, collaborative environment, is detail-oriented, exhibits strong problem-solving skills as related to equipment and manufacturing issues, is self-directed and able to work with limited supervision Qualification and Experience: Required : High-school diploma or GED. Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and Word computer applications. Ability to perform light lifting and carrying duties, and to sit and/or stand for an extended period of time (3-5 hrs.) Preferred : Previous manufacturing experience in a cleanroom environment. Working Conditions: Duties are performed in a cleanroom environment which requires personnel to wear special garments. Cleanroom suits, hoods, shoe covers and gloves are used to maintain the cleanliness of the workspace Location: The Broadcom – Breinigsville, PA site is located in the Lehigh Valley near the cities of Allentown, Bethlehem and Reading. Job Description: Broadcom is a leading global company in infrastructure technology, data center networking, and security, built on decades of innovation, collaboration, and engineering excellence. The Application Networking and Security (ANS) division develops advanced security solutions—including distributed firewall and micro-segmentation technologies—that protect east-west traffic across enterprise data centers. We have an exciting opportunity for a Member of Technical Staff (Professional 4) to join our Security Intelligence Big Data and Analytics team. Today's enterprise networks face an expanding attack surface and an ever-changing threat landscape. Our team is on a mission to meet this challenge by delivering powerful, cutting-edge capabilities for VMware vDefend Advanced Threat Prevention (ATP) and the VMware vDefend Firewall . Hosted on the Security Services Platform (SSP) , Security Intelligence is a state-of-the-art analytics platform that provides deep network security visibility within virtualized data centers. It streamlines software-defined Layer 3-7 firewall network segmentation by offering graphical visualization of workloads and traffic flows, alongside automated security policy recommendations that enable micro-segmentation at massive scale. Our team is looking for engineers who share our passion for innovation in distributed systems, container networking, and big data. You will be working within a massive, polyglot repo using technologies like Kubernetes, Kafka, Redis, MinIO, Apache Spark, and PostgreSQL to empower Security Analysts to keep their environments safe from malicious threats. What You'll Actually Work On Network Policy & Micro-segmentation — Building the analytics engines that generate dynamic policy recommendations to eliminate lateral threat movement. Datacenter-Wide Graphical Visualization — Delivering comprehensive, near real-time graphical visualization of Applications, Groups, VMs, IPs, and aggregated network traffic flows to provide deep visibility into complex modern applications. Metadata Ingestion & "Security as Code" — Building robust data pipelines to ingest Configuration Management Database (CMDB) metadata, automating the definition of hierarchies, bulk tag assignments, group creation, and policy bootstrapping—reducing segmentation planning from months to minutes. Continuous Segmentation Monitoring & Drift Detection — Developing tools that continuously monitor network traffic to surface new or unapproved flows, track traffic leakage (for infrastructure workloads and between environments), and alert administrators to unauthorized activity, ensuring continuous compliance. Runtime Threat Detection & High-Throughput Streaming — Building detection capabilities that identify anomalous behavior and policy violations using high-throughput data processing systems. Distributed & Stateful Workloads — Configuring and managing workloads that require consensus, replication, and fault tolerance—including analytical databases and message buses running on Kubernetes via Operators or StatefulSets. How You'll Work Own components end-to-end — From breaking down ambiguous problems into clear technical design specs, test driven development through to production support. Develop Polyglot Systems — Writing highly performant and scalable code using Go, Java, and Python. Debug across layers — Diagnosing complex issues spanning the Kubernetes control plane, networking (TCP/UDP, HTTP, Antrea CNI, Envoy proxies), and cluster-level stateful workloads using Prometheus, Grafana, kubectl debug, and audit logs. Build automated tests — Validating security correctness and OpenAPI compliance to prevent regressions in a highly scalable micro-service environment. Collaborate across teams — Working closely with platform, UI, and QA engineers, while sharing knowledge and mentoring junior engineers. Ship in agile sprints — Participating in all phases of the software development cycle, utilizing Jira, Confluence, and Git-based workflows. What Makes You a Strong Fit Kubernetes Internals — Hands-on experience with Kubernetes architecture and cluster management. Strong Programming Skills — Deep expertise in Go, Java (big data, stream processing, Spring/SpringBoot), and Python. Distributed Systems & Stateful Workloads — Experience managing consensus, replication, fault tolerance, and running databases (e.g., PostgreSQL-HA, Redis) on Kubernetes. High-Volume Data Systems — Experience with analytical databases (e.g., Apache Druid, ClickHouse), large-scale data ingestion (Kafka), and complex querying workloads. Modern Build Tooling — Experience working in large repos using advanced build systems like Bazel, alongside Docker/Helm deployments. Collaborative Mindset — Ability to work independently on complex problems while collaborating across a global team with a "Team First" mentality. Job Description: Broadcom’s Mainframe Software Division (MSD) is committed to addressing the fundamental needs of our customers by continuously evolving our solutions. We are seeking a Product Owner to join our Workload Automation team in Plano, TX, where you will collaborate closely with R&D to deliver enhancements and new capabilities to a suite of workload automation programs that run the world's largest enterprises. These solutions orchestrate workflows to ensure applications such as payroll gets processed on time, financial institutions start the morning with the correct balance, and so forth. The Product Owner (PO) at Broadcom is essentially the “glue code” between Product Manager (PM) and the Development Team, with their primary value derived from understanding, contributing to, and executing the product and solution strategy. This execution involves breaking down high-level strategic goals into concrete outcomes, which are then further refined with the development team into manageable Enablers or User Stories ready for completion. The PO works on-site within the R&D scrum teams to determine how the work will be completed and is responsible for ensuring what the team has developed successfully covers the customer validated use cases. Additionally, the PO leads customer engagement and customer validation efforts. Product Owner Core Responsibilities Works closely with R&D development teams to maximize the value delivered to the customers Understands how the Enterprise backlog model operates with Epics, Capabilities, Features, and Stories Effectively communicates with both internal and external stakeholders Establishes, prioritizes, and helps sequence backlog items based on defined strategies, events, and dependencies with other teams Ensures the common understanding of backlog items, their acceptance criteria and alignment on definition of done with R&D scrum teams Coordinates with other Product Owners and cross-functional roles throughout the development and delivery process Independently resolves complex project issues and challenges Team Backlog Ownership The principal responsibility of the PO is to maintain a prioritized, transparent, and straightforward backlog of work items that align with the product strategy and enable maximizing the product value. Refines the backlog items with R&D teams to reach a common understanding with sufficient detail for the team to work on for the current and next iteration. Cross-Team and Management Reporting To maintain cadence across many teams globally, PO communication is key to ensure inter-team and cross-team dependencies are communicated and risks to team productivity are shared and mitigated. The PO is responsible for raising information to enable management by exception and is accountable for communication with their PO peers and solution leadership. The PO raises dependencies and potential derailers early so they can be addressed in a timely manner without impacting the delivery schedule. The PO regularly leads projects requiring coordination with other functions or teams while providing guidance to less experienced team members. Customer Engagement Our business success is driven by our customers and in turn by their success. In order to ensure our products solve our customers' challenges we continually iterate on our solutions asking our customers for their feedback. A PO works with their PM and other cross-functional roles, including field technical consultants, creating opportunities to visit customers and observe users in their environment whenever possible. PO actively seeks new opportunities for engagement with customers, builds and strengthens customer relationships. Regular iteration reviews are one of the responsibilities of the PO. The PO decides when it is appropriate to share progress with internal and external stakeholders. In establishing the Sprint Review event, the PO will invite their customers describing the value they may expect to receive. Typically performed over video conferencing, a Sprint Review will showcase the most recent development. Presenting at industry conferences on their product, the technical vertical into which our products integrate, and on relevant adjacencies is strongly encouraged for all POs. When a support case is escalated to the development team for further action, the PO must be aware of the case and may manage the case to completion. Collaboration with Product Manager The PO stands back to back with the PM, working together on the same broader problems but each tackling different areas of work and levels of detail. While the Product Manager is considered ‘outward facing’ in meeting potential customers and buyers, the Product Owner is considered ‘inward facing’ and focused on existing customers and colleagues in development and support. The close collaboration of PO with PM is crucial for the creation of a product roadmap, adjustments and execution on the product strategy, and the overall success of the product Product management oversees market research, monitors competitive activity, and identifies customer needs . Collaboration with Development Teams Consisting of developers, architects, QA, Information Engineers, UX, and R&D management, the Development Team produces the vast majority of consumable output and answers the question “How” will this thing get done. Job Description: Manufacturing Operator Broadcom Lehigh Valley Manufacturing Operator, Cleanroom In this full-time position with competitive pay and excellent benefits, you will interact with colleagues from both operations and engineering while performing activities critical to Broadcom’s success as a premier manufacturer in the high-technology semiconductor industry. Company History: Broadcom is a multinational technology business that develops, manufactures, and sells semiconductors and infrastructure software . AT&T first opened the Breinigsville facility in the late 1980s and this facility served as Bell Labs’ world headquarters for optoelectronics. Through a series of acquisitions, the Breinigsville facility is now an integral part of Broadcom’s Optical Systems Division, manufacturing InP lasers and detectors that support telecommunications customers throughout the world. Position Summary: This manufacturing position involves operating semiconductor-processing equipment in a cleanroom environment. The manufacturing operator is responsible for meeting daily production goals in support of cleanroom fabrication operations. The areas of concentration include photolithography – both coat/develop and pattern exposure – pattern transfer via both wet and dry etching techniques, substrate cleaning via wet chemistry, metrology and other semiconductor processes. Key Duties and Responsibilities: Operate manually- or computer-controlled equipment to meet production and quality goals Work constructively with other team members to process wafers and optical components Utilize computer software to track operational performance and make minor corrections to improve productivity Follow quality management procedures and identify quality issues Maintain a clean and safe working environment Multitask to perform other required duties as assigned by a supervisor The Ideal Candidate: enjoys working hard in a fast-paced, collaborative environment, is detail-oriented, exhibits strong problem-solving skills as related to equipment and manufacturing issues, is self-directed and able to work with limited supervision Qualification and Experience: Required : High-school diploma or GED. Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and Word computer applications. Ability to perform light lifting and carrying duties, and to sit and/or stand for an extended period of time (3-5 hrs.) Preferred : Previous manufacturing experience in a cleanroom environment. Working Conditions: Duties are performed in a cleanroom environment which requires personnel to wear special garments. Cleanroom suits, hoods, shoe covers and gloves are used to maintain the cleanliness of the workspace Location: The Broadcom – Breinigsville, PA site is located in the Lehigh Valley near the cities of Allentown, Bethlehem and Reading. Create and assist in the preparation and development of reports, briefings and presentations for various audiences Assist with event planning, attend and facilitate meetings, workshops, conferences and working group sessions, track status and milestones, and provide summary of meetings and meeting minutes when requested. Required Qualifications: Current TS/SCI Poly clearance is required for this position 10+ years of experience within any Government OR target 5 years within IC or DoD Bachelor's Degree preferred. Demonstrated experience in one or more of the following areas: federal acquisitions, Department of Defense (DoD) or the /Intelligence Community (IC) budget & finance processes, and National Security policy Demonstrated experience in systems engineering or project/program management or both Demonstrated experience working with senior executives at multiple organizational levels Demonstrated experience using Microsoft Office and standard computer applications Demonstrated experience adapting to a rapidly changing work environment while maintaining flexibility and versatility Demonstrated experience fostering solid relationships that promote cooperation and communicate expectations Demonstrated experience analyzing situations and make well informed decisions Demonstrated experience communicating effectively and concisely using a variety of styles and techniques appropriate to the audience Demonstrated ability in oral and written communication skills sufficient to compose and deliver clear and concise responses Ready to Make a Difference? Your Day at Lowe’s You’ll keep shelves stocked and backrooms organized by unloading freight, moving products to the sales floor, and maintaining a clean, safe workspace. You may also assist customers in locating or loading products. Most shifts are physically active, and scheduling may include morning, evening, or overnight hours based on store needs. Key Responsibilities Deliver SMART customer service by assisting customers, answering questions, and offering support during projects Stock merchandise by unloading freight, down-stocking, organizing shelves, and setting up pallets Support store operations by verifying deliveries, completing dock prep, and using equipment like pallet jacks and forklifts Maintain a safe, clean environment by following proper procedures for hazardous materials, equipment use, and housekeeping Operate store equipment including scanners, Zebra phones, balers, and other tools as needed Pitch in as a team player to complete other assigned tasks Additional responsibilities for Pro Fulfillment Stores include: Use the Orders App to pick and stage Flatbed Delivery orders Load delivery orders, ensuring quality, accuracy, and safe loading practices Rotate orders by delivery date and resolve customer order issues Proactively communicate with customers to ensure delivery satisfaction Execute Delivery Readiness best practices Minimum Qualifications High school diploma or GED or equivalent years of experience in lieu of education requirement, if applicable Preferred Qualifications 3 months Experience operating forklift/power equipment such as lifts, order pickers, and similar equipment 6 months Experience in a warehouse performing inventory handling and stocking Lowe’s commitment to growth and teamwork extends to the community as well.
